payload_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the UTF-8 bytes of the payload serialized with RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS): lexicographically sorted object keys, no insignificant whitespace, UTF-8 without BOM, Unicode emitted as scalar values, and RFC 8785 number serialization. Hash input is exactly the payload value, excluding the envelope and payload_sha256 itself.
